name: Arena Swim Snorkel III
description: The durability is the whole story. The frame and seal shrug off seasons of chlorine, the soft liquid-silicone strap stays comfortable long after cheaper straps stiffen, and the purge valve clears easily.

name: Speedo Fastskin dome racing cap
description: A dome cap built for one job — reducing drag. The smooth silicone fits tighter and sleeker than a training cap to shave resistance at the surface, which is why you see it on the blocks at every big meet, often doubled over a first cap.

name: FINIS Freestyler paddle with skeg
description: The specialist. Its elongated shape and bottom skeg act like a keel — cross over your centerline on entry and the paddle tracks crooked so you feel the error instantly.

name: FINIS Swimmer's Snorkel
description: The one we hand to first-timers and never worry about again. It doesn't leak, it stays put on flip turns, and the purge valve clears without a fight, so you can focus on technique instead of the tube.
